newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS reaffirms Great Lakes Power ratings.
newsitem.headline: CBRS reaffirms Great Lakes Power ratings.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Monday in its year-end review that it had reaffirmed an A-1 credit rating on commercial paper issued by Great Lakes Power Inc.
CBRS also reaffirmed its B++ rating on Great Lakes' senior unsecured debentures and added that the company's overall rating outlook remained stable.
"The commercial paper rating is based on a C$100-million authorized borrowing limit and supported by C$100 million in committed bank lines and about C$130 million in cash flow," CBRS said.
CBRS also said the unchanged ratings reflected Great Lakes quality utility assets, conservative balance sheet and earnings and cash-flow diversity.

"As well, competitive electric rates and the improved financial and business condition of Great Lakes' major industrial customers has also enhanced the company's credit position and rating outlook," CBRS said.
Great Lakes reduced its short-term earlier this year with the C$194-million sale of 6.4 million shares of Brascan Ltd.
